summary: Steep residential kerb on Hillsdon Road, homes close on both sides.
reasons: Bus route street, houses all round

best_section.where: Hillsdon Road east kerb, mid-block north of the roundabout

drivers.seclusion: Houses within 12-20 m on both sides; dwelling 12 m away at 33 m, 8 m at start.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so room exists, but the grade is too steep.
drivers.traffic: Bus route and through traffic; noisy.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Gate 284 m away, mapped way round it
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the east side give some afternoon shade.
